Lobs a subwoofer so illegal it counts as both a war crime and a mixtape. Enemies in the blast are forced to dance — then the bass drops THEM. Includes 8 complimentary mixtapes.
Fires a legal document that ricochets between wrongdoers, stamping each one SERVED — served enemies take 40% more damage from EVERYTHING. "Litigation is just crowd control with letterhead." — Blartz
A saw-launcher. Blades ricochet off walls and floors up to three times, shredding everything in the path. Learn to love geometry. Tier 3: blades split on first bounce.
Lobs a micro-singularity that vacuums enemies (and loose bolts) into a clump, then pops them skyward. Slam a gravity-clump for BONUS damage. Physics: now weaponized, now billed.
Deploys a hovering turret-drone that draws enemy aggro and lays down fire for 12 seconds. Outsource your problems. Tier 3: it self-destructs in a taunting explosion when its contract ends.
A crystallizing coolant beam. Freezes enemies into ice statues — SHATTER them with the mallet for a fountain of bolts. Tier 3: shatters spread frost to the whole crowd.
Fires a seed that erupts under a target as a snapping bio-plant, rooting it and chewing for damage. Up to 3 gardens of pain at once. Tier 3: plants spit spores at other enemies.
Max every track to unlock the Ω form:
Kinetic Annihilation & Retribution Emitter Node. Press K: a screen-clearing grievance sweep. Targets comically demand a manager, then explode. Blartz: "I built her a personality. I regret her."

"Void the warranty. Awaken the little guy." Thirty seconds of autonomous, trash-talking, twin-cannon Sprocket — and EVERYTHING you both do hits twice as hard. Charge it by dealing damage. Activate with T (pad: D-pad Up).
MAGMA MALLET — +damage, the head splits with glowing cracks, and every big impact leaves a burning patch. Fire safety documentation sold separately, then recalled.
THUNDER MALLET — +damage, wider finisher shockwave, and lightning arcs off big hits to whoever is standing too close. Legally distinct from any mythological hammer.
Maximum mallet achieved. OSHA has stopped returning Blartz's calls.
A mystery sack of ammunition Blartz 'found'. Refills every weapon you own. Do not ask where it was found. Do not smell it.
Tiny robots that repair your organs and judge your diet. Permanently raises max HP by 20. Side effects include confidence.
Blartz buys back guns for 60% — no questions, no receipts, no dignity.
